description.fr: Tire de loin à l'arc, achève à la lance.
description.en: Shoots from afar with a bow, finishes with a spear.

description.fr: Encaisse et frappe fort au corps à corps.
description.en: Takes the blows and hits hard up close.

description.en: Frail, but their sparks fly over obstacles.
